name: freeform
title: Freeform
description: An infinite whiteboard after Apple's Freeform: a gallery of boards, and a pannable, zoomable canvas of sticky notes, shapes, text, photos, links, connectors that follow what they're glued to, and freehand drawing on PencilKit. Select, move, resize, rotate, group, lock, align and arrange; alignment guides while you drag; Format panel for fills, borders, text, connectors and the board's background; undo and redo per board; scroll to pan, pinch or ⌘-scroll to zoom. Built on the PencilKit core (strokes, inks, tool palette).
